</text>

<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="540.5" y="1090" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="540.5" dy="0">Prob. / Sample</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1118" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">B batch; image layout [B,C,H,W]</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">mlpconv = spatial Conv + two point-wise Conv, each with ReLU</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">32 -> 16 -> 8 -> 1 spatial resolution</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1192" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1222" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1247" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
